## Services
### Sales & supply
As exclusive dealers for Hitachi HVAC Solutions, we supply the complete range for homes, businesses and large projects.
Includes: Inverter, fixed speed & window ACs; Cassette, concealed & ductable units; VRF systems & chillers.

### Installation & commissioning
Correct installation decides how well an AC cools and how long it lasts. Our technicians install, test and hand over every unit.
Includes: Site survey & heat-load sizing; Copper piping, drainage & electrical; Gas charging, testing & demo.

### Annual maintenance (AMC)
Scheduled preventive servicing keeps efficiency high and breakdowns rare, for homes, commercial buildings and large facilities.
Includes: Periodic cleaning & check-ups; Priority breakdown support; Plans for single units to whole sites.

### Repairs & breakdowns
Not cooling, leaking or making noise? Our service team diagnoses and fixes the problem.
Includes: Gas leak detection & refilling; PCB, compressor & fan issues; Service for Hitachi units.

### Central AC projects
VRF, ductable and chiller-based systems for hotels, resorts, hospitals, commercial buildings, offices and industrial facilities, across Rajasthan.
Includes: System design & zoning; Ducting, controls & integration; Commissioning & ongoing AMC.

### Advice & system selection
Tell us about your space and requirement, and we'll recommend the right Hitachi system, residential, commercial or institutional.
Includes: Single rooms to whole buildings; Capacity and system type guidance; Clear, itemised quotation.

## Frequently asked questions
### Is Yamini Enterprises an authorised Hitachi dealer in Jodhpur?
Yes. Yamini Enterprises is the exclusive dealer and service provider for Hitachi HVAC Solutions by Bosch Home Comfort Group in Jodhpur, and an authorised sale and service dealer for Hitachi air conditioners since 2009.

### Which Hitachi AC works best in Jodhpur's summer heat?
Jodhpur summers regularly cross 45°C, so choose a model built for high outdoor temperatures. Hitachi's ductable ACs (Toushi and Takumi), concealed splits and Set Free Sigma VRF systems are listed to work up to 52°C, and the home split range uses Hitachi's Tropical or Expandable Inverter technology. Tell us where the outdoor unit will sit and we'll recommend the right model.

### Where is your showroom?
Our Hitachi showroom is at 134, R.K. Nagar, Opp. B.R. Birla Public School, Jodhpur, Rajasthan 342008. Visit to compare Hitachi models side by side.

### How do I book AC service or a repair?
Call +91 94141 00877 or send us the details on WhatsApp, with a photo of the unit's model sticker if you can. We handle installation, annual maintenance (AMC), gas refilling and repairs for Hitachi units.

### Which AC capacity (tonnage) do I need?
It depends on room size, sun exposure, number of people and appliances. As a rough guide, small bedrooms often need about 1 ton and larger living rooms 1.5–2 tons, but we recommend talking to our team so we can size it correctly.

### Inverter or fixed speed: which should I buy?
Inverter ACs adjust their speed to the cooling needed, so they use less electricity and keep the temperature steadier. They cost more upfront but usually save money if you run the AC for many hours a day. Fixed speed models suit lighter or occasional use.

### Do you handle installation?
Yes. Our technicians handle installation, piping, drainage, electrical connections, testing and a demo.

### What warranty do I get?
All products carry the Hitachi manufacturer's warranty, purchased through Yamini Enterprises as the exclusive dealer in Jodhpur. Ask us for the warranty terms of your model.

### Which areas do you serve?
We primarily serve Jodhpur, and take on HVAC projects across Rajasthan.

### Can you supply in bulk for projects or dealers?
Yes. Alongside individual customers, we handle large-scale projects for hotels, resorts, hospitals, commercial buildings, offices and industrial facilities. Contact us with your requirement for a quotation.

## Inverter Split ACs (22 models)
Page: https://yaminient.in/products/inverter-split-acs/

Yamini Enterprises supplies, installs and services Hitachi inverter split ACs in Jodhpur, as the city's exclusive dealer for Hitachi HVAC Solutions. The range covers the Kashikoi, Merai, Sugoi, ACE, Logicool, Toushi and Takeshi series, in capacities from 1.0 to 2.1 ton.

Best for:
- Bedrooms, living rooms and offices where the AC runs for many hours a day
- Homes that want lower electricity bills and a steadier room temperature
- Rooms from about 100 to 250 sq ft (1.0 to 2.0 ton, depending on sun and occupancy)

How to choose:
- Size it to the room: around 1.0 ton for a small bedroom, 1.5 ton for a typical living room, 2.0 ton for large or sun-facing rooms.
- Most current Hitachi inverter models are listed as stabiliser-free; we check your supply voltage at the site survey.
- Every listed model has Hitachi's Tropical Inverter or Expandable Inverter technology; models such as the Kashikoi 5400X, Merai 3300S and Takeshi 5100X add the iSense activity sensor, and the 3100S series covers the essentials at a lower price.
- Jodhpur summers regularly cross 45°C, so tell us if the outdoor unit will sit on a hot roof or west-facing wall.

### What is the price of a Hitachi inverter split AC in Jodhpur?
Prices depend on the series, tonnage and current offers, and change through the season. Call or WhatsApp Yamini Enterprises for today's price, including installation.

### Which Hitachi inverter AC is best for a bedroom?
For a typical bedroom of about 120 to 150 sq ft, a 1.0 ton inverter split is usually enough; choose 1.5 ton for a larger or sun-facing room. We can recommend the exact model after a quick site check.

### Do you install the inverter AC?
Yes. Our technicians handle installation, copper piping, drainage, electrical connections, testing and a demo, and we provide maintenance and repairs afterwards.

## Fixed Speed Split ACs (9 models)
Page: https://yaminient.in/products/fixed-speed-split-acs/

Yamini Enterprises supplies and installs Hitachi fixed speed split ACs in Jodhpur, a budget-friendly choice for rooms where the AC runs for a few hours at a time. Models include the Zunoh, Logicool and Takeshi 3100F series, from 1.0 to 2.5 ton.

Best for:
- Guest rooms and spaces used occasionally
- Buyers who want a lower upfront price
- Shops and small offices with short daily running hours

How to choose:
- A fixed speed AC runs at full power and switches on and off; it costs less to buy but more to run than an inverter for long daily use.
- If the AC will run more than 6 to 8 hours a day, compare it with an inverter model before deciding.
- Pick the capacity for the room: 1.0 ton for small rooms up to 2.5 ton (Takeshi 3100F) for large spaces.

### Fixed speed or inverter: which is better for me?
Fixed speed ACs cost less upfront and suit lighter or occasional use. Inverter ACs use less electricity when run for many hours a day. Tell us how you'll use the room and we'll recommend one.

### What sizes are available?
Hitachi fixed speed splits at Yamini Enterprises come in 1.0, 1.5, 1.8, 2.0 and 2.5 ton capacities, depending on the series.

### Do you provide installation and service?
Yes. We install, test and hand over every unit, and offer annual maintenance (AMC) and repairs in Jodhpur.

## Window ACs (11 models)
Page: https://yaminient.in/products/window-acs/

Yamini Enterprises sells and installs Hitachi window ACs in Jodhpur, including the Summer, Kaze Plus and Kaze Reidan series. Models range from 1.0 to 2.0 ton and from 2-star to 5-star energy ratings.

Best for:
- Rooms with a suitable window or wall opening
- Rented homes, where a single unit is easier to move
- Buyers who want simple installation with no outdoor unit to mount

How to choose:
- A 5-star model uses less electricity than a 2 or 3-star model of the same size; it pays back faster the more you run it.
- Check the opening size and that the back of the unit can vent freely outdoors.
- 1.0 ton suits small rooms; 1.5 ton is the common choice for bedrooms; 2.0 ton for larger rooms.

### Which star rating should I choose?
If you run the AC for long hours in Jodhpur's summer, a 5-star window AC (such as the Summer QC or Kaze Plus RAW511KUD) saves more on electricity. A 2 or 3-star model costs less upfront.

### Can you install a window AC in my wall?
Yes, if the wall can take a suitable opening. Our team checks the site and handles the installation.

### What is the price of a Hitachi window AC?
Prices depend on the model, tonnage and star rating, and change with the season. Ask Yamini Enterprises for the latest quote.

## Cassette & Concealed ACs (14 models)
Page: https://yaminient.in/products/light-commercial-air-conditioners/

Yamini Enterprises supplies and installs Hitachi light commercial air conditioners in Jodhpur: ceiling cassette ACs, concealed (ducted) splits and Flexi splits for shops, clinics, restaurants and offices. Capacities run from 1.5 to 7.5 ton, and the concealed range is listed to work in temperatures up to 52°C.

Best for:
- Shops, showrooms, clinics and restaurants with false ceilings
- Offices that want even airflow without wall units
- Spaces where the indoor unit should be hidden from view

How to choose:
- Cassette ACs sit flush in the ceiling and spread air in several directions: good for open floors.
- Concealed splits hide above the ceiling and feed air through ducts and grilles: good for a clean interior.
- R410A models are the newer, ozone-friendly refrigerant; R22 models are also listed in the catalogue.
- We size these from the floor area, ceiling height, glass and footfall during a site survey.

### Cassette or concealed AC: which should I choose?
A cassette AC is visible as a ceiling panel and blows air in several directions, ideal for open shops and offices. A concealed AC is hidden above the ceiling and uses ducts, ideal when you want only grilles visible. We'll suggest the right one after seeing the space.

### Do these ACs work in Jodhpur's summer heat?
Hitachi's concealed split range is listed to operate in outdoor temperatures up to 52°C, which covers Jodhpur's peak summer.

### Do you handle the false-ceiling and ducting work?
We plan and install the AC, ducting, drainage and controls, and coordinate with your interior contractor for the ceiling.

## Ductable ACs (26 models)
Page: https://yaminient.in/products/ductable-air-conditioners/

Yamini Enterprises designs, supplies and installs Hitachi ductable air conditioners in Jodhpur and across Rajasthan. The Toushi and Takumi series run from 3 to 16.5 ton, with scroll or rotary compressors, and most models are built for high ambient temperatures up to 52°C.

Best for:
- Banquet halls, showrooms, restaurants and large floors
- Hotels, hospitals and offices that need cooling through ducts
- Projects where one system should cool several connected areas

How to choose:
- Ductable ACs need a ducting layout, so they are best planned with the building or interior design.
- Twin-circuit and multi-compressor models keep part of the cooling running if one circuit needs service.
- Choose R410A models for the newer, ozone-friendly refrigerant; R22 models are also available.
- Heat-load sizing matters at this scale: we calculate it from the area, occupancy, glass and use.

### What capacities do Hitachi ductable ACs come in?
The Toushi and Takumi ranges at Yamini Enterprises cover 3, 4, 5, 5.5, 7.5, 8.5, 11 and 16.5 ton, including single-circuit, twin-circuit, ceiling-suspended and convertible models.

### Are Hitachi ductable ACs suitable for Rajasthan's heat?
Yes. Most Toushi and Takumi models are listed with a high ambient design that works up to 52°C outdoors.

### Do you take on projects outside Jodhpur?
Yes. We handle HVAC projects across Rajasthan, from design and supply to installation, commissioning and AMC.

## VRF Systems (21 models)
Page: https://yaminient.in/products/vrf-systems/

Yamini Enterprises designs, supplies and installs Hitachi VRF (variable refrigerant flow) systems in Jodhpur and across Rajasthan. The range includes Set Free Sigma outdoor units from 8 to 24 HP, rated for tropical ambient temperatures up to 52°C, plus wall, ceiling and cassette indoor units and central controllers.

Best for:
- Hotels, hospitals, offices and large homes with many rooms
- Buildings where each zone needs its own temperature control
- Projects that want central control and lower running costs than many separate splits

How to choose:
- One VRF outdoor unit connects to many indoor units, each controlled separately.
- Indoor units come in wall, low-height ceiling, high air quantity ceiling, and 1, 2 and 4-way cassette types.
- Central control stations (such as PSC-AD128EX) let you manage every unit from one place.
- VRF needs design up front: we size the outdoor units, piping and zones for your building.

### What is a VRF system?
A VRF (variable refrigerant flow) system connects one or more outdoor units to many indoor units, varying the refrigerant to each room so every zone can be cooled to its own setting. It suits hotels, hospitals, offices and large homes.

### Which Hitachi VRF models do you supply?
Hitachi Set Free Sigma outdoor units from 8 to 24 HP, wall, ceiling and cassette indoor units, an AHU kit, and wired remotes and central control stations.

### Do Hitachi VRF systems work in high temperatures?
The Set Free Sigma range is listed for a tropical ambient operating range up to 52°C.

## Chillers (3 models)
Page: https://yaminient.in/products/hitachi-chillers/

Yamini Enterprises supplies Hitachi chillers for large projects in Jodhpur and across Rajasthan: air-cooled screw chillers (45 to 450 TR), water-cooled screw chillers and direct drive centrifugal chillers (300 to 1100 TR), all using R134a refrigerant.

Best for:
- Hospitals, malls and large commercial buildings
- Industrial plants and process cooling
- Central plants serving many air-handling units

How to choose:
- Air-cooled screw chillers need no cooling tower and suit sites with limited water.
- Water-cooled chillers are more efficient at large scale but need a cooling tower and water supply.
- Centrifugal chillers suit the largest loads, from 300 to 1100 TR.

### Air-cooled or water-cooled chiller: which is right?
Air-cooled chillers are simpler to install and need no cooling tower, which helps where water is scarce. Water-cooled chillers are more efficient for very large loads but need a cooling tower. We advise based on your load and site.

### What capacities are available?
Hitachi air-cooled screw chillers range from 45 to 450 TR, and direct drive centrifugal chillers from 300 to 1100 TR. Water-cooled screw chillers are also available.

### Do you handle chiller projects across Rajasthan?
Yes. Contact Yamini Enterprises with your requirement for a project quotation.
